base_model: v2.7 calibrated ensemble; no model retraining.

tiers.Strong Pick: Ensemble and logistic public gates agree on the same non-pass outcome.
tiers.Model Lean: Ensemble has a usable directional signal, but the logistic safety layer blocks a strong public pick.
tiers.Pass: Signal is too close, too draw-heavy, or data quality is too weak.

note: Model Lean is intentionally not marketed as a high-confidence pick.
